relationships.subject: FMRP
relationships.evidence_quote: FMRP puncta exhibited notable colocalization with calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP) immunoreactivity selectively in female spinal cord

relationships.subject: FMRP
relationships.evidence_quote: In DRG neuron terminals, it directly binds Cav2.2 to regulate synaptic vesicle exocytosis

key_findings: FMRP is expressed in human DRG and spinal neurons and nociceptor axons, most abundant in substantia gelatinosa.
FMRP puncta colocalize with CGRP+ axons in female (about 19-28%) but not male (5-7%) human spinal cord.
